breakdowns.site: Commercial Breakdown Operations — 4-Day Machine Stoppage & Rs 20,000–25,000 Idle Wages vs Delayed Rs 5,000 Quotation Discount
breakdowns.issue: A major operational breakdown was reviewed where a machine remained completely immobilized for 4 consecutive days awaiting an external vendor repair quotation (estimated repair cost approximately Rs 90,000 to Rs 95,000). The service desk delayed action attempting to negotiate a Rs 5,000 to Rs 7,000 price discount. Meanwhile, the client site operator and dedicated service mechanic sat completely idle for 4 days, incurring direct idle wages and customer billing penalties exceeding Rs 20,000 to Rs 25,000. Furthermore, the external vendor failed to arrive or provide the quotation by the 3rd day, repeatedly citing busy schedules.
breakdowns.action: Dhruv Sharma and Sushil Mishra severely reprimanded the team for false economy and penny-pinching while incurring massive daily operational losses. Ordered immediate group-wide escalation: demand the quotation within hours; if the vendor continues stalling, mobilize immediately or source an alternative vendor so the machine is not paralyzed.
breakdowns.status: Commercial Escalation — 4-Day Breakdown Costing Rs 20k–25k in Idle Wages to Save Rs 5k; Group Escalation Mandated

breakdowns.site: Vadodara Project Site — JCB 3246 Electric Scissor Lift Battery Charger Requisition & Porter Dispatch
breakdowns.issue: A JCB 3246 electric scissor lift operating at the Vadodara site was grounded due to a missing/faulty high-frequency battery charger, halting platform charging cycles. Requisition had been submitted via the central Google Form.
breakdowns.action: Jitendra Budhauliya verified the Google Form submission and confirmed that a replacement battery charger was tested, packaged, and dispatched yesterday via Porter/express courier. Material is scheduled for on-site delivery today or early tomorrow.
breakdowns.logistics: Dispatched yesterday via Porter / express parcel courier; tracking details shared with site operator.
breakdowns.status: Spares Dispatched — Battery Charger Pack En Route via Porter; Arrival Expected Today/Tomorrow

breakdowns.site: Bhatinda / Central Fleet & Field Supervisor Dubey — Digital Load Cell Stock Allocation & Supplier Payment Standoff
breakdowns.issue: Digital load cell sensors required for a grounded machine under field supervisor Dubey remained unsent. Clarification was sought on whether the load cells were out of stock in central inventory or withheld due to supplier payment delays, leaving the machine immobilized.
breakdowns.action: Jitendra Budhauliya instructed to cross-check physical inventory with Pardeep Tomar and coordinate immediate fund clearance with finance. Ordered express dispatch of the load cell kit directly to Dubey to restore the machine to working condition.
breakdowns.status: Immobilized — Machine Idle Pending Load Cell; Vendor Payment & Stock Allocation Escalated

breakdowns.site: Guwahati Project Site & Greater Noida Fleet — Supervisor Prakash Alignment & Unit 600 Manifold Oil Leakage Overhaul
breakdowns.issue: (1) Guwahati project site supervisor Prakash required operational briefing on site reporting discipline and machine upkeep. (2) At Greater Noida, Unit 600 boom lift is operating with an active hydraulic manifold oil leak ('thoda leaking leke ja raha hai') and is due for periodic maintenance servicing within 2 to 5 days.
breakdowns.action: Direct telephone discussion was completed with supervisor Prakash to align project workflows. Service engineering team instructed to inspect Greater Noida Unit 600 manifold seals, rectify the oil leak, and execute full periodic servicing within the week.
breakdowns.status: Operational Briefing Completed — Unit 600 Manifold Leak Repair & Periodic Servicing Scheduled

breakdowns.site: Field Procurement & Invoicing Discipline — Unverified Local Invoicing Freeze & Mandatory Serial Number Tagging (Chunnilal / Pune Lal)
breakdowns.issue: Field technicians (Chunnilal, Pune Lal, etc.) routinely submit local store bills for hydraulic hoses, hardware fittings, and lubricants (totaling Rs 12,000 to Rs 15,000) days after making purchases without including machine model, machine serial number, or item photographs. Central management cannot ascertain which equipment consumed the parts or verify billing legitimacy.
breakdowns.action: Management instituted a strict financial directive: all unreferenced local store bills are frozen. Field staff are strictly prohibited from purchasing parts locally without prior telephonic authorization. Every vendor invoice submitted MUST carry the exact machine serial number, purpose, and instant photographs of the parts upon collection.
breakdowns.status: Process Violation Rectified — Unreferenced Field Bills Frozen; Mandatory Pre-Approval & Serial Number Tagging Enforced

breakdowns.site: Genie Z135 Ultra Boom Lift (Jammu / MP Site) — Costly Electronic Control Card Purchase Freeze & Central Diagnostic Laptop Mobilization
breakdowns.issue: Site operator Anil Kumar Rai and technician Vinod Pal submitted a Google Form request for an expensive replacement electronic control card for a Genie Z135 boom lift, claiming the card is defective. However, the machine has been operating intermittently for months, and earlier checks indicated occasional power supply drops rather than a dead card. Purchasing a high-value card based solely on an operator's claim was strongly contested.
breakdowns.action: Senior field service engineer Ram Babu is currently on site. Management directed that instead of ordering an expensive electronic card blindly, the central store diagnostic laptop (stored under Pradeep Tomar's custody) must be dispatched immediately to Ram Babu. Ram Babu and Raj Kishore will connect the laptop, run full diagnostic software scans, inspect electrical supply traces, and verify whether a card replacement or economical repair is warranted.
breakdowns.status: Diagnostic Hold — Costly Electronic Card Purchase Frozen; Diagnostic Laptop Dispatched to Ram Babu for Full Scan

breakdowns.site: Central Store Freight Logistics Optimization — Multi-Modal Dispatch Coordination & Porter Spend Restraint
breakdowns.issue: Inconsistent coordination across diverse freight modes (Train cargo, Air parcel, Surface courier, Porter) resulted in unnecessary shipping expenditures, such as paying unneeded Rs 200 Porter charges for small hand-carried pipes (e.g. pipe delivered to Shukla Ji) that could have been consolidated or carried directly.
breakdowns.action: Pardeep Tomar instructed to centralize all outbound material handoffs directly under his supervision, optimize logistics mode by consignment urgency and weight, and eliminate wasteful, unvetted on-demand Porter bookings.
breakdowns.status: Logistics Review — Freight Modes Consolidated Under Store Desk; Local Porter Spend Controlled

breakdowns.site: Sahani Project Site — Electric Scissor Lift Periodic Servicing & Charger Deep-Discharge Investigation
breakdowns.issue: A scissor lift operating at the Sahani project site is overdue for scheduled periodic servicing due to technician delays. The site reported charging failure, with ambiguity over whether the traction battery bank is deeply discharged or the on-board charger has suffered an internal hardware fault.
breakdowns.action: Assigned service engineer instructed to proceed to the Sahani machine immediately today. Technician mandated to measure battery cell open-circuit voltage and specific gravity, test charger output with a multimeter before logging a replacement, and execute complete on-site servicing.
breakdowns.status: Assigned for Service — Technician Dispatched to Sahani Site; Battery Voltage vs Charger Diagnostic Prioritized

directives.title: Strict Ban on Prolonging Equipment Breakdowns for Quotation Discounts
points: True Cost-of-Downtime Awareness: Tolerating 4 days of machine breakdown (costing Rs 20,000–25,000 in idle operator/mechanic wages and lost client billings) simply to seek a Rs 5,000–7,000 vendor discount is strictly prohibited.

Rapid Supplier Escalation SLA: If a repair or parts vendor fails to submit a quote or send a technician within 24 hours, the case must be escalated to executive leadership or transferred immediately to alternative vendors.

directives.title: Mandatory Diagnostic Laptop Verification for High-Value Electronic Parts
points: No Orders Based Solely on Operator Claims: Expensive electronic control cards (e.g. Genie Z135) must NEVER be ordered based on operator verbal claims or superficial checks.

Mandatory Field Laptop Hookup: Qualified senior technicians (Ram Babu) must connect the diagnostic laptop to interrogate live system controllers, read fault codes, and test power delivery before approving part purchases.

directives.title: Rigid Invoicing Protocols & Mandatory Machine Serial Number Tagging
points: Prior Verbal/Written Authorization: Field mechanics and supervisors must obtain management pre-approval before procuring parts, hydraulic hoses, or lubricants from local vendors.

Zero Reimbursement Without Serial Numbers & Photos: Every vendor bill submitted to accounts or WhatsApp groups must explicitly state the machine serial number, purpose, and include physical photos of the items upon receipt.

directives.title: Centralized Multi-Modal Freight Optimization & Porter Spend Restraint
points: Consolidated Dispatch Control: The store desk must evaluate transport urgency and route packages through the most cost-effective mode (Train cargo, Express Air, Surface courier) rather than relying on expensive piecemeal Porter bookings.
Elimination of Ad-Hoc Courier Spends: Small hand-deliverable spares must be coordinated with traveling technicians rather than incurring separate courier fees.
